raw_response:
I am old now, so I do not like to change too much unless I see a strong reason. On my 10.1 mu, I will still do wheat and maize one after the other, same as we have done for many years. Wheat and maize together are safer for my family. Wheat gives a steady harvest, and maize follows right after, so the land does not sit empty. I have well water, but pumping costs money, so I only irrigate when the crop really needs it. I finished many seasons already, and from what I have seen, if I save too much on fertilizer, the wheat ears get thin and maize also loses strength. So I will put a solid base fertilizer, then add a bit more later if the crop looks weak. I do not talk in very exact technical ways, but I know my land. I watch the color of the leaves, the rain, and what nearby farmers are doing. Because my family is big, we have enough hands for most work, so I only hire a little help if timing gets tight around wheat harvest and maize planting.
